title: Cancel pending systemd jobs
summary: Cancel jobs that are stuck or waiting, which can help if shutdown or suspend is hanging.

steps.explain: If a specific service like suspend is stuck, stop it explicitly.

rollback.explain: There is no direct rollback. If you canceled a necessary job, you may need to restart the service or reboot.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the service you want to restart.

warnings: Canceling jobs can leave the system in an inconsistent state. Use only if the system is unresponsive to normal commands.
